will: FYI support reports apparent double billing when a stream resumes to another shard and a toolcall is truncated.

sam: any req ids or tiny log?

will: req_20260402_11, snippet: provisional=64 on host-A, resumed->host-B final=192, toolcall_truncated=true.

maria: sounds like provisional on A never got cleared before B confirmed. we need join keys in ledger.

sam: I'll add x-resume-session header and emit provisional_id + provisional_route + toolcall_truncated flag.

jen: UX: show provisional vs confirmed in request detail and highlight route mismatch. feature-flag it.

ops-bot: Incident INF-3499 created: "resume+truncate billing review" assigned eng-platform.

maria: short-term: analytics dedupe by resume_session within 2m window and flag suspects. long-term: carry provisional_id so resumed host can claim/clear.

sam: repro plan: force disconnect mid-toolcall, route resume to another shard, force truncation, capture ledger. I'll upload trace.

j: noted. post traces here and I'll wire the provisional row once telemetry lands.
